name: intent
title: User intent hooks and provider
description: @interlace/ui — typed, vendor-neutral user intent: activate, view, dwell, commit, disclosure and form hooks, `data-intent` for server components, rage clicks and page view/leave, all reported through one `IntentProvider` adapter. Sends nothing that identifies a person.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/intent

Installed to `hooks/use-intent.ts`.


Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/intent
